summary: Local Bounti filed an 8-K on November 4, 2026, disclosing that the NYSE accepted its request for a nine-month extension to regain compliance with the Section 802.01B Minimum Market Capitalization Standard. The original February 5, 2026 notice cited average 30-trading-day global market cap below $50 million alongside stockholders' equity below $50 million. The cure period now runs to August 5, 2027, the maximum 18-month window permitted under NYSE rules. Compliance requires either a $50 million 30-day average market cap or $50 million stockholders' equity by that date; the stock continues trading during the cure period subject to NYSE quarterly review. Watch for insufficient-progress warnings, dilution from any equity raise used to cure, and suspension risk if fundamentals do not improve.
